description: Claim one issue through the hosted claim API. App-aware: when the Greenlight Claims app is installed on the repo the claim goes through the app backend; otherwise it posts as a plain protocol comment and says so. REPORT-MODE SAFE: dry run unless execute is true; executing needs a stored token (greenlight auth login) or the token argument.

api_base.description: Override the hosted claim API base URL.

eta_days.description: ETA in days recorded in the protocol claim comment (eta-days: line).

execute.description: Post the claim for real. Defaults to false: dry run returns the plan only.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

plan.description: Plan recorded in the protocol claim comment (plan: line).

queue_ok.description: Join the public queue when someone else holds the active claim.

token.description: API token passthrough; prefer the stored token from greenlight auth login.

name: claim_via_api
